description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View named ChatSheet that manages a chat interface, utilizing environment variables, state management, and navigation. It constructs the UI layout for a chat component with dismiss functionality and dynamic title based on agent name.

classes.name: ChatSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a chat interface with dismiss functionality and dynamic chat title.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes ChatSheet with a GatewayNodeSession, session key, optional agent name, and user accent color. Sets up the chat view model with transport based on the session.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view layout, including navigation, the chat view component, and toolbar.

methods.name: chatTitle
methods.description: Computes the dynamic title for the chat, defaulting to 'Chat' if no agent name is provided or it is empty.
